memory_annotations.evidence_summary: Marcus selected one Monday evening outbound for further planning and retained two Wednesday nonstop returns pending confirmation of the meeting end time and the hotel decision. No durable travel preference was established.

messages.content: I need flights for a two-day opening review in the Phoenix area. The first walkthrough is at 9:00 Tuesday, January 13, and we're supposed to finish by 4:00 Wednesday. I should fly out of Chicago Monday evening.
Which suburb is the restaurant in, and should I search from O'Hare only or include Midway? Also, has the Wednesday finish time been confirmed firmly enough to book the return now?
It's in Chandler near the Fashion Center. Check both airports. The local team still hasn't told me whether Wednesday could run late, so I want to see a practical return and a later backup.

Understood. For Monday, I'll look for an arrival that leaves enough time to collect a bag if needed, get to Chandler, and still have a reasonable night before the 9:00 a.m. start. For Wednesday, I'll compare one flight based on a 4:00 p.m. finish and one that still works if the meeting runs roughly an hour and a half late. Are you checking a bag?
No checked bag. I can leave for the airport directly from the site Wednesday.

The cleanest Monday option is American 1865 from ORD, departing at 6:10 p.m. and arriving at PHX at 8:55 p.m. It is nonstop. Allow about 15 to 25 minutes to reach the rideshare pickup area, then approximately 25 to 35 minutes to Chandler at that hour. You would likely reach a hotel near the site around 9:45 to 10:10 p.m. A Midway option leaves earlier, at 4:40 p.m., but it does not materially improve Tuesday morning and takes more of the workday.
Keep the 6:10 from O'Hare. What are the Wednesday choices?

If the meeting ends at 4:00 p.m., United 2142 leaves PHX at 6:35 p.m. and reaches ORD at 10:58 p.m. From Chandler Fashion Center, a typical late-afternoon drive is 25 to 40 minutes, but traffic or a crash can push it higher. Leaving the site by 4:15 should put you at the terminal around 4:50 to 5:10, giving you about 85 to 105 minutes before departure.
That works only if they actually stop on time. What's the later one?

American 1952 departs PHX at 8:45 p.m. and arrives at ORD at 1:08 a.m. Thursday. If the meeting runs until 5:30, you could leave by 5:45 and ordinarily reach the terminal around 6:20 to 6:45. That preserves roughly two hours before departure, even with heavier traffic. It is operationally safer but makes for a very late arrival home.
Any useful option between those two? I don't need a huge cushion if we finish at four, but I don't want a connection.

There is a nonstop Southwest flight from PHX to MDW at 7:35 p.m., arriving at 11:40 p.m. It gives you another hour over the 6:35 flight, but a 5:30 finish would still leave limited margin: departing Chandler around 5:45 could mean reaching the terminal only 50 to 75 minutes before takeoff. It is a reasonable middle choice only if the overrun is expected to be brief.
No, carry the United 6:35 and American 8:45 forward. We'll decide once I know the hotel and whether Wednesday is likely to run late. Don't book anything yet.

I’ll hold the comparison at three nonstop candidates: Monday outbound, American 1865 from ORD at 6:10 p.m., arriving PHX at 8:55 p.m.; Wednesday return option one, United 2142 at 6:35 p.m., arriving ORD at 10:58 p.m.; and Wednesday return option two, American 1952 at 8:45 p.m., arriving ORD at 1:08 a.m. Thursday. The earlier return is workable with a firm 4:00 p.m. finish and a prompt departure from Chandler. The later return remains viable if the meeting runs to about 5:30. Nothing has been booked.

They will use the hotel shuttle after landing, return to SEA by shuttle around 8:30 a.m. Thursday, and rideshare to the relatives' home for an estimated 9:45 to 10:00 a.m. arrival. The return change cost $174 total. They should reach SEA around 9:50 a.m. Sunday and expect to arrive home in Chicago around 7:05 to 7:30 p.m. For the Phoenix-area opening review near Chandler Fashion Center on January 13-14, no flights have been booked. Carry forward American 1865 from ORD Monday at 6:10 p.m. to PHX at 8:55 p.m., plus Wednesday return candidates United 2142 at 6:35 p.m. to ORD at 10:58 p.m. and American 1952 at 8:45 p.m. to ORD at 1:08 a.m. Thursday. The return decision remains open pending the hotel selection and confirmation of whether Wednesday's meeting may run past 4:00 p.m.
